description.hook: Betty has had enough of waiting for the nightclub to reopen. Catalina has a ballroom.
paragraphs: With the Meridian still closed after a fire, Betty Boop and Mabel are out of work and thoroughly tired of discussing it. A sailing holiday promises sunshine, good food, and a change of company. Popeye knows his way across the water. Hamish Gravlin—Ham, or “Gravy” when Betty feels like it—has the boat, the manners, and a remarkable ability to avoid ordinary employment.

On the island, Mabel finds someone worth dancing with, Betty finds fresh possibilities for mischief, and the Casino offers more than an evening’s entertainment. Then a photograph gives the search for Olive Oyl an unexpected direction.
A romantic island adventure full of affectionate comedy, theatrical opportunity, and people discovering how much their pleasures—and their loyalties—may cost.
